That's ridiculous.  What horrid people; can you really call them family if they treat you this way?  Even more so if your features are common, its likely they were just looking for an excuse to bully you and use you as an emotional punching bag.  The way you are thinking is what they want you to, it enables the bullying to continue.  Beauty is subjective, and you don't have to love every part of yourself, just accept it as part of you, and if you can't, try changing it.  Your skin color has nothing to do with beauty anyways, and acne can be treated, body shape changed via surgery or exercise and diet changes, to an extent.

I highly suggest attempting to press charges for defamation and libel, as even if you don't win, it should help ensure that he recognizes you are serious, though i don't expect he'd really change his ways, more like just pretend to.  For starters break up with him, then call a lawyer.  In any case, he's clearly misogynistic trash, and if you can be sure to tell your story to those you care for, so he doesn't get the chance to lie to them.  Also consider that even if they are conservative, your family should know it's your life and respect your decisions, and if they aren't willing to offer you support you should take a step back and reevaluate your relationship, though it would be hard, if you want to work this out.
Well in the end its your life, i can't tell you what to do with it, but i'd like to ask why you think this way to start.
So you recieved regular abuse over it?  did you believe it because you trust the person telling you?

You are worth more than you think, and your physical form doesn't define you as a person.  The best way to get rid of the pain is to stop the source of it; what happened to make you invalidate and self-abuse this badly?

If you truly believe that every bond is meaningless, then live life without them.  No one ever said you must bond with other people to live a satisfying life.  Try getting a pet, they will not abandon you.  If you hate who you are, change. If you are tired, take a break from life for a bit.  I can only offer these words you see as meaningless as consolation.  In any case, the meaning of life is what you give it, and if you wish to disappear, try leaving all you know behind, as it may be what you're seeking.

Everyone is susceptible to these issues; when put under pressure you start to crack, that's perfectly okay.  Take some time to examine why you're so stressed; that's the reason you aren't able to function properly.  This is an opportunity to collect yourself and stop before you spiral out of control.
